commit.message:
Enable llms generation and per-page download button for HIP
 (#8315)
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

## Motivation

Make the HIP documentation more accessible to AI coding assistants and
agents. rocm-docs-core 1.38.0 introduces LLM-friendly output (llms.txt /
llms-full.txt) and a per-page Markdown download button. This PR opts HIP
into both features so readers and agents can discover the docs via a
standard llms.txt index, pull the full documentation as a single file,
and copy individual pages directly into an AI context window.

## Technical Details

Bump rocm-docs-core to 1.38.0 and add the llms extra alongside
api_reference so llms.txt and llms-full.txt are generated, enable the
feature with rocm_docs_generate_llms, and turn on the per-page Markdown
download button.

Specifically:
- docs/sphinx/requirements.in: rocm-docs-core[api_reference]==1.33.1 →
rocm-docs-core[api_reference,llms]==1.38.0. The llms extra is optional
in 1.38.0 and pulls in sphinx-markdown-builder, which drives the doctree
→ Markdown conversion.
- docs/conf.py: set rocm_docs_generate_llms = True, and set
html_theme_options["use_download_button"] = True after the ROCmDocs
SPHINX_VARS are applied.
- docs/sphinx/requirements.txt: regenerated with pip-compile in an
Ubuntu / Python 3.12 environment (matching Read the Docs) so no
Windows-only packages leak in. Adds sphinx-markdown-builder==0.6.10;
existing api_reference pins (doxysphinx, sphinxcontrib-doxylink) are
preserved.

## JIRA ID

AIROCDOC-4080

## Test Plan

- Built the HIP docs locally with a full sphinx -b html build (including
the doxygen / api_reference step) using rocm-docs-core 1.38.0 with the
llms extra installed.
- Confirmed the generated requirements.txt is free of Windows-only
dependencies (e.g. pywin32) so the Read the Docs (Ubuntu / Python 3.10)
build resolves cleanly.

## Test Result

- Build succeeded (exit 0).
- llms.txt (~12 KB) and llms-full.txt (~1.6 MB) generated in the HTML
output directory.
- Per-page Markdown download button renders (dropdown-download-buttons
present in the built pages).
- requirements.txt contains rocm-docs-core[api-reference,llms]==1.38.0
and sphinx-markdown-builder==0.6.10, with no pywin32.
